measurements.name: Neck
measurements.method: Around the base of the neck, over the prominent neck bone at the back and just above the collarbones at the front.
measurements.notes: Shirt-collar measurements are usually taken slightly higher (mid-neck) with one finger of ease.

measurements.name: Neck Depth
measurements.method: Vertical drop from the neck-point level (where neck meets shoulder) to the desired front neckline at centre front.
measurements.notes: A style measurement, not a fixed body landmark. Some systems measure from the base of the throat instead of the neck-point level.

measurements.name: Chest
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the chest, under the arms and across the shoulder blades, tape level.
measurements.notes: For women most systems use Bust instead; Chest on a female block often means Upper Chest.

measurements.name: Upper Chest
measurements.method: Around the body high under the arms, above the bust at the front.
measurements.notes: Often used with High Bust to choose a pattern size for full-busted clients.

measurements.name: Bust
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the bust and straight across the back, tape level, client wearing the bra they will wear with the garment.

measurements.name: High Bust
measurements.method: Around the body directly under the arms, above the fullest part of the bust and across the shoulder blades.
measurements.notes: Some systems treat High Bust and Upper Chest as the same measurement.

measurements.name: Under Bust
measurements.method: Around the rib cage directly beneath the bust, tape snug and level.

measurements.name: Bust Point
measurements.method: From the neck point (high point of shoulder) down to the bust apex.
measurements.notes: Also called shoulder-to-apex or bust-point length. Some systems start at the shoulder point instead.

measurements.name: Bust Separation
measurements.method: Straight distance between the two bust apexes.
measurements.notes: Also called bust span or apex-to-apex.

measurements.name: Waist
measurements.method: Around the natural waist: the narrowest part of the torso, usually just above the navel. Ask the client to bend sideways; the crease marks it.
measurements.notes: Trouser waists are often taken lower, where the client wears the waistband; record which one you use.

measurements.name: Stomach
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the abdomen, usually at or just below the navel.
measurements.notes: Also called belly or tummy. Important for kaftans, senator and trousers on fuller clients.

measurements.name: High Waist
measurements.method: Around the torso a few centimetres above the natural waist.
measurements.notes: Definitions vary: some systems use midway between under-bust and waist, others a fixed 5 cm above the waist.

measurements.name: Shoulder Width
measurements.method: Across the back from one shoulder point (the bony tip of the shoulder) to the other, following the curve of the shoulders.
measurements.notes: Also called across shoulder. Some tailors measure straight across rather than over the curve.

measurements.name: Shoulder Length
measurements.method: Along the top of one shoulder from the neck point to the shoulder point.

measurements.name: Cross Back
measurements.method: Across the back between the creases where the arms join the body, about midway between the nape and the underarm level.
measurements.notes: Also called across back or back width.

measurements.name: Cross Front
measurements.method: Across the chest between the front arm creases, above the bust.
measurements.notes: Also called across chest or chest width.

measurements.name: Armhole
measurements.method: Around the arm where it joins the body: over the shoulder point and under the armpit.
measurements.notes: Also called armscye. Some tailors take it with the arm relaxed at the side, others with the arm slightly raised.

measurements.name: Front Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down over the bust (or chest) to the natural waist.
measurements.notes: Also called front waist length.

measurements.name: Back Length
measurements.method: Down the centre back from the nape (the prominent bone at the base of the neck) to the natural waist.
measurements.notes: In many systems Back Length and Nape to Waist are the same measurement. Some tailors record back length to the desired top length instead.

measurements.name: Torso Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front of the body to the crotch level.
measurements.notes: Varies widely. Bodysuit and jumpsuit patterns may use 'torso girth' instead: a full loop from the shoulder, down the front, through the crotch and up the back.

measurements.name: Bust Height
measurements.method: Vertical distance from the neck-point level straight down to the level of the bust apex.
measurements.notes: Bust Point follows the body to the apex; Bust Height is the straight vertical drop. Some systems use only one of the two.

measurements.name: Shoulder Slope
measurements.method: The vertical drop from the neck-point level to the shoulder point.
measurements.notes: Some systems record this as an angle in degrees, or classify it (square, normal, sloping) rather than measuring it.

measurements.name: Upper Arm
measurements.method: Around the arm just below the armpit, arm relaxed.
measurements.notes: Many systems use a single 'upper arm / bicep' measurement at the fullest part.

measurements.name: Bicep
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the upper arm, arm relaxed at the side.
measurements.notes: Some tailors take it with the arm flexed for fitted sleeves on athletic clients; note which.

measurements.name: Forearm
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the forearm, just below the elbow.

measurements.name: Elbow
measurements.method: Around the elbow. Take it with the elbow slightly bent so a fitted sleeve can still bend.

measurements.name: Wrist
measurements.method: Around the wrist just above the wrist bone.
measurements.notes: Cuff measurements add ease on top of this.

measurements.name: Sleeve Length
measurements.method: From the shoulder point down the outside of the arm, over the slightly bent elbow, to the wrist bone.
measurements.notes: Some systems measure from the centre-back neck over the shoulder to the wrist (common for dress shirts). Record the method.

measurements.name: Short Sleeve Length
measurements.method: From the shoulder point down the outside of the arm to the desired short-sleeve hem.
measurements.notes: A style measurement: the hem may sit anywhere from mid upper arm to just above the elbow.

measurements.name: Shoulder to Elbow
measurements.method: From the shoulder point down the outside of the arm to the point of the elbow.

measurements.name: Elbow to Wrist
measurements.method: From the point of the elbow down the outside of the forearm to the wrist bone.

measurements.name: Armhole Depth
measurements.method: Vertical distance from the nape down to the underarm level, measured at centre back.
measurements.notes: Also called scye depth. Some systems measure from the shoulder point or neck point instead of the nape.

measurements.name: Round Sleeve
measurements.method: Around the arm at the level where the sleeve will end, including the ease the client wants.
measurements.notes: A Nigerian tailoring term. Some tailors take it at the bicep (fullest part), others at the sleeve hem; record which.

measurements.name: High Hip
measurements.method: Around the top of the hip bones, a few centimetres below the waist.

measurements.name: Hip
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the hips and buttocks, feet together, tape level.
measurements.notes: Many systems use Hip and Seat for the same measurement.

measurements.name: Seat
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the buttocks, checked from the side so the tape stays level.
measurements.notes: Menswear systems usually say Seat; womenswear usually says Hip.

measurements.name: Waist to Hip
measurements.method: Down the side of the body from the natural waist, over the curve of the hip, to the hip level.
measurements.notes: Hip Depth is the straight vertical version of this measurement.

measurements.name: Thigh
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the thigh, just below the crotch.

measurements.name: Mid Thigh
measurements.method: Around the thigh midway between the crotch and the knee.

measurements.name: Knee
measurements.method: Around the knee, over the kneecap, leg straight.
measurements.notes: Some tailors measure with the knee slightly bent for fitted trousers.

measurements.name: Calf
measurements.method: Around the fullest part of the calf.

measurements.name: Ankle
measurements.method: Around the ankle just above the ankle bone.
measurements.notes: For trouser hems (leg opening), tailors usually add ease or measure around the heel and instep instead.

measurements.name: Inseam
measurements.method: Down the inside of the leg from the crotch to the ankle bone.
measurements.notes: Some systems measure to the floor, others to the desired trouser hem; record which.

measurements.name: Outseam
measurements.method: Down the outside of the leg from the waist to the ankle bone.
measurements.notes: Often taken to the floor instead. Trouser Length uses the same line, ending at the desired hem.

measurements.name: Front Rise
measurements.method: From the front waist at centre front, down and between the legs to the crotch point.
measurements.notes: Front rise + back rise = crotch length. Some trouser systems measure rise on the finished garment rather than the body.

measurements.name: Back Rise
measurements.method: From the back waist at centre back, down over the seat to the crotch point.

measurements.name: Crotch Depth
measurements.method: Vertical distance from the waist level down to the crotch level.
measurements.notes: Also called body rise. The most common method is seated: measure at the side from the waist down to the chair seat.

measurements.name: Crotch Length
measurements.method: From the front waist, down between the legs and up to the back waist, following the body.
measurements.notes: Also called crotch seam, total rise or through-crotch.

measurements.name: Trouser Length
measurements.method: From the waist at the side down to the desired trouser hem, usually just above the floor.
measurements.notes: A finished-garment length: the break (where the hem sits on the shoe) varies by style. Outseam is the body version.

measurements.name: Waist to Knee
measurements.method: Down the side of the body from the natural waist to the middle of the knee.

measurements.name: Knee to Ankle
measurements.method: Down the outside of the leg from the middle of the knee to the ankle bone.

measurements.name: Seat Depth
measurements.method: Vertical distance at the back from the waist level down to the fullest point of the seat.
measurements.notes: Used mainly in menswear trouser drafting; womenswear often uses Hip Depth instead.

measurements.name: Hip Depth
measurements.method: Straight vertical distance from the waist level down to the hip level.
measurements.notes: Also called waist-to-hip depth or hip height. Waist to Hip is the version measured over the curve.

measurements.name: Height
measurements.method: Standing straight without shoes, from the floor to the top of the head.

measurements.name: Full Body Length
measurements.method: From the nape down the centre back to the floor.
measurements.notes: Some systems start at the neck point; record which.

measurements.name: Nape to Waist
measurements.method: Down the centre back from the nape to the natural waist.
measurements.notes: Identical to Back Length in most systems.

measurements.name: Shoulder to Waist
measurements.method: From the neck point straight down the front to the natural waist level.
measurements.notes: Front Length follows the body over the bust; this is the straight version. Many Nigerian measurement sheets treat them as one.

measurements.name: Shoulder to Hip
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front of the body to the hip level.
measurements.notes: Used for tops, peplums and jackets that end at the hip.

measurements.name: Waist to Floor
measurements.method: From the natural waist straight down to the floor, client standing without shoes.
measurements.notes: Some tailors measure down the side of the body; others measure at centre front. Results differ slightly over the hip.

measurements.name: Shoulder to Floor
measurements.method: From the neck point straight down to the floor.
measurements.notes: Key measurement for floor-length garments. Some systems start at the shoulder point.

measurements.name: Dress Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front to the desired hem; the default shown is knee length.
measurements.notes: A style measurement: mini, knee, midi and maxi lengths all use this line, ending at different points.

measurements.name: Gown Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front to the floor (or to the desired hem for a floor-length gown).
measurements.notes: Add heel height when the client will wear heels with the gown.

measurements.name: Skirt Length
measurements.method: From the natural waist down to the desired hem; the default shown is just below the knee.
measurements.notes: Some tailors measure skirt length from the waistband position rather than the natural waist.

measurements.name: Shirt Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front to the desired shirt hem, usually covering the seat.
measurements.notes: Some tailors measure shirt length at the back from the nape instead.

measurements.name: Agbada Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front to the desired agbada hem, usually just above the ankle.
measurements.notes: Agbada sleeve width (shoulder to the end of the draped sleeve) is a separate measurement. Length varies by style and the client's preference.

measurements.name: Senator Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front to the desired senator top hem.
measurements.notes: Styles range from mid-thigh to just below the knee; the default shown sits above the knee.

measurements.name: Kaftan Length
measurements.method: From the neck point down the front to the desired kaftan hem, usually just above the ankle.
measurements.notes: Short kaftans (to the knee) use the same line with a higher hem.

measurements.name: Head Circumference
measurements.method: Around the widest part of the head: across the forehead about 2 cm above the eyebrows, above the ears and around the back.

measurements.name: Head Width
measurements.method: Straight distance across the widest part of the head, above the ears.
measurements.notes: Best taken with a ruler or calipers rather than a tape. Used for headwear and gele shaping.

measurements.name: Hat Circumference
measurements.method: Around the head where the hat or cap will sit, usually across the forehead and above the ears.
measurements.notes: Same as Head Circumference in most systems. Caps like the fila may be measured slightly higher.

measurements.name: Vertical Body Measurement
measurements.method: A generic vertical measurement between two levels, for custom points the tailor defines.
measurements.notes: Use this template when a client needs a measurement not in the standard list; name it in the order notes.

measurements.name: Hem Circumference
measurements.method: Around the hem of the finished garment (skirt, gown or trouser leg).
measurements.notes: A garment measurement, not a body measurement: it records how wide the client wants the hem.

aliases.note: Listed twice in the brief (lengths and specialised); stored once under lengths.
